<action type="say">
I can help you book an electrician for that.

To get this scheduled, I need a few details:

1) Location  
• What’s the full address where the work needs to be done (street, city, ZIP)?

2) Timing  
• How urgent is this? (emergency today / same day / routine)  
• What’s your preferred date and time window (e.g., tomorrow morning, 1–4 pm, evenings after 6, etc.)?

3) Problem details  
• Is the outlet completely dead, sparking, or working intermittently?  
• Does a breaker trip when you try to use it?  
• Is this a standard outlet or a GFCI (with test/reset buttons)?

4) Provider preferences  
• Minimum rating (e.g., 4.0+, 4.5+), or should I just pick a top-rated option?  
• Any preference for years of experience or specific certifications, or no preference?

5) Your contact info for the booking  
• Full name  
• Mobile number  
• Email (optional but helpful for confirmations)

Once you send these, I’ll find an electrician that matches and move ahead with booking a time for you.</action>
